poses.caption: Place a loop band above your knees and hold a quarter squat with feet hip-width apart.
Step sideways with the lead foot, keeping knees aligned and tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in while keeping a gap between your feet. Continue controlled steps, then reverse direction.

poses.caption: Lift into a bridge with a band around your thighs, feet planted and head and shoulders resting on the floor.
Lift one foot and draw that knee toward your chest while keeping the hips level.
Return that foot and lift the other knee, maintaining bridge height. Alternate steadily, then lower the hips.
